text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's aimless wanderings 
continued. The back of Biwa Hayahide she 
had chased for so long was gone, and she 
had lost sight of even which direction to 
take.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more she ran, the deeper the darkness 
grew. On the verge of forgetting why she 
was even struggling, all she could do was 
scream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. Sakura Laurel 
told Narita Brian: I will run ahead of you 
and become the one you aspire to beat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I will show you what lies beyond the light 
you showed me. Just as you were always out 
in front, standing as the one I admire 
most.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel swore to herself that she 
would show Narita Brian the future she 
strove for through her running. To make 
that a reality, she headed to the race.
